channel.gotify.desc: Send messages through a self-hosted Gotify server
channel.gotify.field.url.desc: server root address, supporting templates; /message is appended when the path does not already end with it
channel.gotify.field.token.desc: application token sent in the X-Gotify-Key header, supporting templates
channel.gotify.field.priority.desc: message priority from 0 to 10, supporting templates; sent only when supplied
channel.gotify.error.invalid_token: the token holds a control character the HTTP header cannot carry
channel.gotify.error.empty_content: the body is empty and no title is available as a fallback
channel.gotify.error.invalid_priority: priority must be a whole number from 0 to 10, got {{.Value}}
channel.gotify.error.http_status: the Gotify server replied with status {{.Status}}: {{.Body}}
channel.gotify.warn.truncated: the message was cut at the {{.Limit}} character limit
